task.timing_contract: Only calendar months through t-1 enter predictors for month t. This is a retrospectively revised and seasonally adjusted bulk snapshot, not an as-issued forecast archive. Calendar lags do not establish historical release availability; the nominal origin is after prior-month releases. No month-t prices/employment or CPI accounting decomposition enters inputs.
task.calibration: All regression coefficients, centering/scales and flexible centers fit only preceding development blocks. No held-quarter target fitting.
task.independent_unit: Whole calendar quarter; forward chronological development folds and2023-onward confirmation. One national economic system, overlapping lag windows and persistent macro shocks; quarters are not independent economies.
task.scope_limits: 1990–2026 US selected national seasonally adjusted series. Revised historical values and seasonal factors can incorporate later information. No causal Phillips-curve, policy intervention, operational financial-return or structural-inflation law claim.

exposure.schema: Native series IDs, date ranges, dictionary units and filenames inspected; no reserved numerical targets or metrics printed before freeze. Source public/source-aware.

task.uncertainty_policy: Quarter-group errors/ranges; no row bootstrap or independent-quarter population confidence. Confirmation will become exposed.

baseline_families: regularized32-center radial-basis regressor with identical eight inputs
selection: Minimum mean-quarter development MAE; prefer fewer coefficients if within1percent of minimum. Compare all attempted candidates against baselines; selecting a baseline is allowed.
stopping: At least5distinct hypotheses; continue when scientifically discriminating hypothesis remains and development improves accuracy/worst-group or supported interpretation; stop after2consecutive substantive no-gain attempts.
primary_metric: mean across quarter groups of mean absolute error in percentage points
